items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: in New York we recorded together with Elmo Hope.

ctx.x: Your association with him continued beyond the Collegians.

Yes, as a matter of fact in New York we recorded together with Elmo Hope. We didn’t have much of an association beyond that, because our paths didn’t cross too much. While I was with Basie, I didn’t see him that much, except during the time we did record with Elmo Hope.
How would you characterize your writing for the Collegians? In what style? Your Frank Foster style, or were you working some particular style?
